May be An AI Researcher.

Greetings!
Zilin Xiao (肖子霖) is a junior undergraduate from the top-notch class (拔尖计划试验班) in the Department of Computer Science, Sichuan University (SCU) supervised by Prof. Yanan Sun.
He is now a research intern at Chengdu Research, MEGVII Technology (Face++) supervised by Prof. Shuaicheng Liu, focusing on unsupervised image alignment and 3D vision, especially optical flow and stereo matching.
He is expected to receive his B.Eng degree from Sichuan University in Jun. 2022. And he will join the Computer Science Engineering Department, the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CSE@CUHK) in Aug. 2022 as an MPhil candidate, supervised by Prof. Liwei Wang.
His recent research interests mainly lie in Computational Photography and 3D Scene Understanding, while he had research experience in Neural Architecture Search and Multiple Object Tracking.

Tips: Enquiries relating to personal projects are preferred to be discussed at the issue topic of the specific repository or via emails. Other methods of contacting me (QQ, Wechat, etc.) ARE NOT welcomed unless advised.
